From: s.patel@synthetic-controls.example
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:14:00 +0530
Subject: RE: Tank demo timing / high-level tuning and shutdown semantics

Asha / Jin,

CR-004 is now approved. Please treat 0.80 m as the effective T1 high limit. Also use 12 s after T1 reaches low level before opening the drain valve, and 8 s after T2 reaches low before the next fill starts.

No state-logic change from DR-02: SHUT remains higher priority than STOP; during SHUT, V2 and V3 stay commanded open until both low-level conditions are satisfied. START during SHUT is ignored.

Jin - the archived Modelica demo still says 0.78 / 10 / 10. Please do not use those three values as configuration authority for the hackathon test log.

Regards,
Samir

-----Original Message-----
From: a.mehta@synthetic-customer.example
Sent: Tuesday, March 10, 2026 16:42
To: s.patel@synthetic-controls.example
Subject: RE: Tank demo timing

We can accept 0.80 m for T1 high. The operators also prefer a little longer settling after transfer, so make that 12 s. The 10 s dead time after tank 2 is empty feels unnecessarily slow; 8 s is acceptable.

-----Original Message-----
From: j.lin@synthetic-sim.example
Sent: Monday, February 16, 2026 11:05
To: s.patel@synthetic-controls.example
Subject: Model parameters used in demo

My current model has T1_high=0.78 m and all three waits at 10 s. STOP is implemented as a latch that forces all valves closed; START clears it. I have not modeled the SHUT priority question yet.
